items.title: Don Albert and Herbert Hall Interview, 1978-08-03
items.q: At all of them, Lee Lewis, we picked up a time party.

ctx.x: No, but I mean the guys who were there at the time, mainly. We just only picked up a couple.
At all of them, Lee Lewis, we picked up a time party.
I believe I was the only who was in Louisiana, born. In New Orleans, one of them in the band, in the Cotsville. They got the good and the good boys in New Orleans.
